previous_exact_full_exit: 주인공은 앞서 나눈 역할 증거와 미검증 공격 과제 옆에 점프·직선 가속·측면 이동의 빈 측정 항목을 놓고, 허용된 개인 시간에서 간단한 출발·방향전환을 숫자 없이 예행했다. 자기 폭발력과 덜 안정적인 측면 회복은 직접 느꼈지만, 정식 Combine 수치·의료 판정·구단 평가·정확 지명 순번은 얻지 못했다. 그 준비에 쓴 시간만큼 코너 한 드리블 과제의 추가 반복은 줄었다.

source_candidate_selection.CF03_choice: 가능한 범위의 슈팅·짧은 공격·연결을 워크아웃 과제로 시도한다
source_candidate_selection.CF03_cost: 잘하는 역할만 반복해 평가를 보호할 기회 대신 미완성 기술의 실패 위험을 감수한다
source_candidate_selection.CF04_choice: 직접 받은 지시를 확인하고 해당 위치·선택을 다음 시도에서 수정해 본다
source_candidate_selection.CF04_cost: 처음 시도한 표본만 남기고 평가를 끝낼 기회를 포기하고 수정이 안 될 위험을 다시 노출한다

fictional_instruction_authority.may: Set and observe this fictional practice task and give its one bounded correction.
fictional_instruction_authority.may_not: Issue an NBA invitation, club grade, medical clearance, combine result, draft promise or authentic scout statement.

actions.action: One permitted private coached practice block is set for corner catch-and-shoot form, a short one-dribble attack, and a simple nearby outlet. The coach can instruct this practice, not certify an NBA workout or issue a club grade.
actions.observable_result: The protagonist knows the three tasks and that this is a personal preparation workout only.

actions.action: From a corner catch he sets and releases a shot without a recorded make. On the next ball he takes one dribble toward the middle, stops before another self-created move, and waits too long to move the ball to the nearby practice partner.
actions.observable_result: The release is visible but its make rate is unknown; the one-dribble stop and delayed simple connection expose a specific decision limit. There is no live defender win.

actions.action: The coach points to the observed stop and asks him to identify the nearby outlet before the next short attack, then make the simple pass if a second self-created action is not there.
actions.observable_result: He receives one instruction about a position and a choice in this practice; it is not a real scout quote, team feedback or official assessment.

actions.action: He repeats the corner start once, takes the same short dribble, stops at the same limit, looks to the pre-identified nearby partner and sends a simple pass rather than forcing a second creation.
actions.observable_result: One pass reaches the practice partner in an unopposed drill. The stopping point still exists; shot accuracy, live-read speed and game transfer remain unproved.

direct_present_cost: He spends this permitted block exposing a failed one-dribble continuation instead of repeating only his reliable defensive/rebounding role; he then uses one more attempt to reveal whether the correction is possible, with no grade or pick benefit promised.
selected_design_exit_state: 주인공은 허용된 가상 개인 지도 훈련에서 코너 캐치 슛을 시도했으나 성공률은 기록하지 않았다. 짧은 한 드리블 뒤 다음 자가 창조가 막혀 가까운 동료에게 공을 늦게 연결한 첫 한계를 지도자가 직접 지적했다. 그는 다음 한 번의 시도에서 같은 정지 지점을 만나자 미리 확인한 가까운 동료에게 단순 패스를 건넸다. 이 국소 수정 행동은 보였지만 실제 수비 상대·경기·구단 평가·공식 측정·정확 지명 순번에서의 성공은 증명되지 않았다.

observed: one-dribble stop and delayed first outlet
one simple pass on bounded retry
unknown: live defender read or game transfer
NBA club workout invitation or acceptance
